name: DropZone
docs: A dashed area that takes files by drag and drop or by a file input. The words come from props; the files are handed to the `files` event, nothing is uploaded here.

props.name: chooseLabel
props.docs: accessible name of the file input

svelte.reason: drag and drop and the programmatic click on the file input need DOM APIs (DataTransfer, element lookup by id): the behaviour is written by the programmer behind the `files` port
